description: This file contains unit tests for URL normalization functions, including various test cases for scheme validity, authority components, port normalization, escape sequences, high-bit URL characters, UTF-8 encoding, username/password handling, dot segment removal, and URL equivalence checks.

methods.name: void check_url_normalizable(const char * url,unsigned int normalizable)
methods.description: Checks if a URL is considered normalizable based on the expected boolean flag.

methods.name: void check_normalized_url(const char * url,const char * expect)
methods.description: Asserts that the normalized URL matches the expected string.

methods.name: void compare_normalized_urls(const char * url1,const char * url2,unsigned int equal)
methods.description: Compares two URLs to determine if they normalize to the same string based on the 'equal' flag.

methods.name: void check_normalized_url_length(const char * url,size_t len)
methods.description: Verifies the length of the normalized URL matches the expected length.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__scheme(void)
methods.description: Unit test for URL schemes and their normalization.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__authority(void)
methods.description: Unit test for authority components of URLs.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__port(void)
methods.description: Unit test for port normalization and validation.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__port_normalization(void)
methods.description: Checks port normalization to standard form.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__general_escape(void)
methods.description: Tests URL normalization with escape sequences in path and query components.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__high_bit(void)
methods.description: Checks handling and normalization of high-bit (non-ASCII) characters in URLs.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__utf8_escape(void)
methods.description: Verifies normalization of UTF-8 encoded characters in URLs.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__username_pass(void)
methods.description: Tests URL normalization with percent-encoded username and password components.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__length(void)
methods.description: Checks the computed length of normalized URLs.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__dots(void)
methods.description: Verifies removal and normalization of dot segments ('./', '../') in URL paths.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__equivalents(void)
methods.description: Tests URL equivalence after normalization, including case insensitivity and default ports.

ctags.name: check_url_normalizable
ctags.pattern: /^static void check_url_normalizable(const char *url, unsigned int normalizable)$/

ctags.name: compare_normalized_urls
ctags.signature: (const char * url1,const char * url2,unsigned int equal)
